dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250911-MLI-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250911-MLI-01) A flood occurred on Sep 11 2025 in Mali. It affected an estimated 434721 people and 371911 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
